name: Garden Heart Anniversary Site
description: Create the complete architecture and experience design for a premium romantic storytelling website called "The Garden Inside My Heart" — a first-month anniversary gift from a husband to his wife. Deliverables include storyboard, UX flow, motion plan, technical architecture, and development roadmap. Technology stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Lenis. Do NOT generate code until architecture is approved. Design areas: emotional journey, all scenes from opening to ending, diary interaction, page-turn animations, flower-growth interactions, bouquet reveal, mobile-first interactions, typography and color system, component architecture, folder structure.
